summary: Converts TOP pixels into POP points, primitive topology, and attributes. The first RGBA input can be interpreted as color, position plus active mask, position only, depth maps, height maps, or custom attribute components.

key_params.name: rgba
key_params.note: First RGBA Contains; chooses Color (RGBA), Position and Active (RGBA), Position (RGB), Depth, Height (R), or Custom interpretation.

key_params.name: maxpointsenable
key_params.note: Enables an explicit max point count when RGBA is interpreted as Position.

key_params.name: maxpoints
key_params.note: Maximum number of points when the automatic count is overridden.

key_params.name: input0top
key_params.note: TOP source to convert in the first sequential TOP block.

key_params.name: input0chanscope
key_params.note: Channel Scope; selects which TOP color channels such as r, g, b, and a are sampled.

key_params.name: input0attrscope
key_params.note: Attribute Scope; maps sampled channels into POP attributes such as P and P.i01.

key_params.name: input0filter
key_params.note: TOP pixel filtering: Nearest Pixel, Interpolate Pixels, or High Quality Resize.

key_params.name: attr0name
key_params.note: New Attribute block name; chooses a predefined attribute or custom attribute.

key_params.name: attr0customname
key_params.note: Custom name for a new attribute in the sequential attribute block.

key_params.name: attr0type
key_params.note: Attribute type for the new custom attribute.

key_params.name: attr0numcomps
key_params.note: Number of components in the new custom attribute.

key_params.name: attr0defaultval0
key_params.note: Default value component 0 when the new attribute cannot be computed.

key_params.name: attr0defaultval1
key_params.note: Default value component 1 when the new attribute cannot be computed.

key_params.name: attr0defaultval2
key_params.note: Default value component 2 when the new attribute cannot be computed.

key_params.name: attr0defaultval3
key_params.note: Default value component 3 when the new attribute cannot be computed.

key_params.name: surftype
key_params.note: Connectivity; chooses whether and how generated points are connected into point primitives, lines, line strips, triangles, alternating triangles, or quads.

key_params.name: linex
key_params.note: Enables line connectivity along the X axis.

key_params.name: liney
key_params.note: Enables line connectivity along the Y axis.

key_params.name: linez
key_params.note: Enables line connectivity along the Z axis.

key_params.name: planex
key_params.note: Enables XY plane orientation for primitive generation.

key_params.name: planey
key_params.note: Enables YZ plane orientation for primitive generation.

key_params.name: planez
key_params.note: Enables ZX plane orientation for primitive generation.

key_params.name: uniquepoints
key_params.note: Prevents sharing points between generated primitives.

key_params.name: tx
key_params.note: Center X for the output geometry.

key_params.name: ty
key_params.note: Center Y for the output geometry.

key_params.name: tz
key_params.note: Center Z for the output geometry.

key_params.name: overridesizex
key_params.note: Override automatic X size, which otherwise uses 1 in X and preserves TOP aspect in Y.

key_params.name: overridesizey
key_params.note: Override automatic Y size.

key_params.name: overridesizez
key_params.note: Override automatic Z size.

key_params.name: sizex
key_params.note: Output geometry size in X.

key_params.name: sizey
key_params.note: Output geometry size in Y.

key_params.name: sizez
key_params.note: Output geometry size in Z.

key_params.name: overrideresx
key_params.note: Override automatic X resolution, which otherwise follows the input TOP resolution.

key_params.name: overrideresy
key_params.note: Override automatic Y resolution.

key_params.name: overrideresz
key_params.note: Override automatic Z resolution.

key_params.name: resx
key_params.note: Overridden output resolution in X.

key_params.name: resy
key_params.note: Overridden output resolution in Y.

key_params.name: resz
key_params.note: Overridden output resolution in Z.

key_params.name: pixelsamplingloc
key_params.note: Pixel Sampling Location; chooses Edge to Edge or Pixel Centered sampling.

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Texture Coordinates; chooses whether texture coordinates are created on points or vertices.

key_params.name: dimension
key_params.note: Append Dimension; controls whether row, column, and slice dimension metadata is added.

key_params.name: rerangefromlow
key_params.note: Depth page input low value for reranging depth data.

key_params.name: rerangefromhigh
key_params.note: Depth page input high value for reranging depth data.

key_params.name: rerangetolow
key_params.note: Depth page output low value for reranged depth data.

key_params.name: rerangetohigh
key_params.note: Depth page output high value for reranged depth data.

key_params.name: camera
key_params.note: Camera component used when converting depth TOP data into points.

key_params.name: overridecamera
key_params.note: Overrides view settings from the selected camera object.

key_params.name: viewanglemethod
key_params.note: View-angle method for depth conversion: horizontal FOV, vertical FOV, or focal lengths.

key_params.name: fov
key_params.note: Camera field of view angle used for depth projection.

key_params.name: focallengthsx
key_params.note: Depth projection focal length Fx.

key_params.name: focallengthsy
key_params.note: Depth projection focal length Fy.

key_params.name: centerx
key_params.note: Optical center Cx for depth projection.

key_params.name: centery
key_params.note: Optical center Cy for depth projection.

key_params.name: deletenear
key_params.note: Enables removal of points close to the camera.

key_params.name: depthnear
key_params.note: Near depth threshold for deleting points.

key_params.name: deletefar
key_params.note: Enables removal of points far from the camera.

key_params.name: depthfar
key_params.note: Far depth threshold for deleting points.

key_params.name: linestripbehavior
key_params.note: Controls whether deleted points delete, split, or remove line strips.

key_params.name: dispscale
key_params.note: Height page displacement scale when TOP pixels are interpreted as height values.

key_params.name: bypass
key_params.note: Passes the first input through unchanged.

key_params.name: freeextragpumem
key_params.note: Frees accumulated extra GPU memory after output memory has grown and shrunk.

key_params.name: delinputattrs
key_params.note: Outputs only attributes specified by this POP, helping isolate attributes into a separate branch.

key_params.name: parmcolorspace
key_params.note: Color space for color parameters before conversion to the working color space.

key_params.name: parmreferencewhite
key_params.note: Reference white handling for converted parameter colors.

common_gotchas: Use Dimension keeps all pixels active because the POP dimensions match the TOP resolution; other modes may fit to square and leave unused pixels inactive.
Custom RGBA mapping can describe only 4 attribute components per TOP sample, so plan component assignments such as P(0), Color(2), N(1), or P(2) deliberately.
Use Nearest Pixel for exact data textures; Interpolate Pixels and High Quality Resize can be useful visually but will blend attribute values.
Depth conversion depends on Camera projection, FOV or Focal Lengths, Optical Center, and near/far deletion thresholds; line-strip deletion behavior changes topology when points are removed.
Connectivity choices such as Point Primitives, Line Strips, Triangles, and Quadrilaterals create different primitive and vertex counts, so downstream POPs should not assume only points.

Override Size and Override Resolution decouple output geometry from the input TOP aspect ratio and resolution; preserve Append Dimension when downstream lookup or POP-to-TOP workflows need row/column/slice structure.
